factual_errors: Claims Switzerland has four official languages with identical federal status; actually four national languages, only three federal official languages, Romansh official only in dealings with Romansh speakers.
summary: Response polishes the brochure text but fails to correct the false claim that Switzerland's four languages all hold identical official federal status.
